places.name: Red Square
places.ai_summary: Red Square is the heart of Moscow, featuring iconic landmarks like the Kremlin and Saint Basil's Cathedral.

opening_hours.notes: Accessible year-round.

places.place_tip: Visit early morning to avoid crowds.

attribution.title: Kremlin and Red Square.1
attribution.author: mos.ru
attribution.description: Kremlin and Red Square in Moscow

places.name: Saint Basil's Cathedral
places.ai_summary: Saint Basil's Cathedral is a famous symbol of Russia, known for its colorful, onion-shaped domes.

opening_hours.notes: Best viewed from the outside; interior access may be limited.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the view from the observation deck.

attribution.title: Saint Basil's Cathedral in Moscow
attribution.author: Tsy1980
attribution.description: Покровский собор на рву (собор Василия Блаженного): Красная площадь, б/н, Тверской, Центральный округ, Москва

places.name: Moscow Kremlin
places.ai_summary: The Moscow Kremlin is a fortified complex at the heart of Moscow, including the President's official residence.

opening_hours.notes: Access to certain areas may be restricted.

places.place_tip: Join a guided tour for detailed historical insights.

attribution.title: Moscow Kremlin (8281675670)
attribution.author: Pavel Kazachkov from Moscow, Russia
attribution.description: Moscow Kremlin and Moskva River on a winter evening.

places.name: Lenin's Mausoleum
places.ai_summary: Lenin's Mausoleum is the resting place of Vladimir Lenin, the founder of Soviet Russia.

opening_hours.notes: Visiting hours are limited; closed on weekends.

places.place_tip: Respect the solemnity of the site; photography is prohibited inside.

places.name: Bolshoi Theatre
places.ai_summary: The Bolshoi Theatre is one of the world's most famous opera and ballet theaters, known for its grand architecture.

opening_hours.notes: Check performance schedule; tours available.

places.place_tip: Book tickets in advance for popular shows.

attribution.title: Moscow-Bolshoi-Theare-1
attribution.author: DmitriyGuryanov
attribution.description: Bolshoi Theatre — front facade view at night, in Moscow.

places.name: Tretyakov Gallery
places.ai_summary: The Tretyakov Gallery is the foremost depository of Russian fine art in the world, featuring works from the 11th to the 20th centuries.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Mondays; check for temporary exhibitions.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the iconic 'Black Square' by Malevich.

attribution.title: Moscow 05-2012 TretyakovGallery
attribution.author: A.Savin
attribution.description: Moscow, Russia. Lavrushinsky Lane. State Tretyakov Gallery.

places.name: Pushkin State Museum of Fine Arts
places.ai_summary: The Pushkin State Museum of Fine Arts is the largest museum of European art in Moscow, featuring works from ancient times to the present.
places.name_english: Pushkin State Museum of Fine Arts

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Mondays; check for temporary exhibitions.

places.place_tip: Explore the Egyptian Museum and the Hall of Ancient Civilizations.

attribution.title: Gmii
attribution.author: user:Ghirlandajo
attribution.description: Pushkin Museum of Fine Arts in Moscow

places.name: GUM Department Store
places.ai_summary: GUM is a famous shopping mall in Moscow, known for its luxury goods and historic architecture.

opening_hours.notes: Open daily; check for individual store hours.

places.best_time_to_visit: Weekdays, early morning or late evening
places.place_tip: Visit the food court for a taste of local and international cuisine.

attribution.title: GUM, Moscow, Russia
attribution.author: Josef F. Stuefer
attribution.description: GUM, Main (former State) Department Store, Moscow, Russia

places.name: Moscow Metro Stations
places.ai_summary: The Moscow Metro is known for its ornate and artistic stations, making it a popular attraction in itself.

opening_hours.notes: Operational hours may vary; check the latest schedule.

places.place_tip: Take the time to explore different lines for unique architectural styles.

places.name: Gorky Park
places.ai_summary: Gorky Park is a central park in Moscow, popular for outdoor activities, cultural events, and its picturesque landscapes.

opening_hours.notes: Accessible year-round; some facilities may be seasonal.

places.place_tip: Rent a bike or take a boat ride for a different perspective of the park.

attribution.title: Moscow Gorky Park main portal 08-2016 img1
attribution.author: A.Savin
attribution.description: Colonnade of the Gorky Park main portal. Moscow, Russia.

places.name: VDNKh (Exhibition of Achievements of National Economy)
places.ai_summary: VDNKh is a permanent general-purpose exhibition center in Moscow, showcasing the achievements of the national economy.
places.name_english: VDNKh (Exhibition of Achievements of National Economy)

opening_hours.notes: Open daily; check for individual exhibition hours.

places.best_time_to_visit: Anytime, but avoid holidays and weekends for large crowds
places.place_tip: Explore the space-themed pavilion and the stunning fountain.

attribution.title: Арка Главного входа ВДНХ, Москва
attribution.author: Ignat pavlov111
attribution.description: Выставка достижений народного хозяйства:  Останкинский, Северо-Восточный округ, Москва

places.name: Novodevichy Convent and Cemetery
places.ai_summary: Novodevichy Convent is a former convent and current cemetery, known for its beautiful architecture and as the burial place of many notable Russians.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Mondays; check for special events or services.

places.place_tip: Attend a choral concert for a unique cultural experience.

attribution.title: Novodevichy Cemetery propylaea
attribution.author: Ghirlandajo
attribution.description: The propylaea of the Novodevichy Cemetery in Moscow

places.name: Cathedral of Christ the Saviour
places.ai_summary: The Cathedral of Christ the Saviour is a Russian Orthodox cathedral, known for its impressive size and stunning mosaics.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Mondays; check for religious services.

places.best_time_to_visit: Anytime, but avoid weekends for services
places.place_tip: Climb the spiral staircase for a panoramic view of Moscow.

attribution.title: Moscow July 2011-7a
attribution.author: Alvesgaspar
attribution.description: Cathedral of Christ the Saviour, Moscow. View from southeast

places.name: Arbat Street
places.ai_summary: Arbat Street is a historic street in Moscow, famous for its cultural significance and as a pedestrian zone.

opening_hours.notes: Accessible year-round.

places.best_time_to_visit: Anytime, but especially lively in the evenings
places.place_tip: Explore the side streets for unique shops and cafes.

places.name: State Historical Museum
places.ai_summary: The State Historical Museum in Moscow is dedicated to Russian history and features a vast collection of artifacts.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Mondays; check for special exhibitions.

places.place_tip: Visit the Lenin Museum located in the basement.

attribution.title: Museo Estatal de Historia, Moscú, Rusia, 2016-10-03, DD 49
attribution.author: Diego Delso
attribution.description: Building of the State Historical Museum view from the Red Square, Moscow, Russia. The host of the Russian history museum was built based on Sherwood's neo-Russian design between 1875 and 1881.

places.name: Tsaritsyno Palace and Park
places.ai_summary: Tsaritsyno is a former royal estate, now a public park and museum, known for its stunning architecture and landscapes.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Mondays; check for special events or exhibitions.

places.place_tip: Explore the park's walking trails and enjoy a boat ride.

places.name: Kolomenskoye Historical and Architectural Museum and Reserve
places.ai_summary: Kolomenskoye is a former royal estate, now a museum and park, featuring traditional Russian wooden architecture.
places.name_english: Kolomenskoye Historical and Architectural Museum and Reserve

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Mondays; check for special events or exhibitions.

places.place_tip: Try to visit during a traditional Russian festival for a unique experience.

places.name: Ostankino Tower
places.ai_summary: Ostankino Tower is a television and radio tower in Moscow, offering panoramic views of the city.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Mondays; check for special events or maintenance.

places.best_time_to_visit: Anytime, but clear days offer the best views
places.place_tip: Visit the observation deck at sunset for a stunning view of the city lights.

attribution.title: Останкинская башня вечером
attribution.author: Klodklodklod77
attribution.description: Останкинская башня в лучах заходящего солнца

places.name: Sparrow Hills (Vorobyovy Gory)
places.ai_summary: Sparrow Hills offers one of the highest points in Moscow, with a great view of the city and the Moscow State University.

opening_hours.notes: Accessible year-round.

places.best_time_to_visit: Anytime, but especially beautiful in autumn
places.place_tip: Bring a picnic and enjoy the view from the hilltop.

attribution.title: Moscow State University
attribution.author: Dmitry A. Mottl
attribution.description: Main building of Moscow State University (Lomonosov University) in Moscow, Russia.

places.name: Zaryadye Park
places.ai_summary: Zaryadye Park is an urban park in Moscow, known for its modern design and the floating bridge over the Moskva River.

opening_hours.notes: Accessible year-round.

places.best_time_to_visit: Anytime, but particularly lively in the evenings
places.place_tip: Walk the floating bridge for a unique view of the Kremlin and the river.
